screen: Deduplicate archived rows by (field_prime,target_index,offsets,vector), retaining the first shift only, in source order. Independently reconstruct U,V and test aU+bV=O for all 6656 events. Retain all screens.
lift_selection: Construct every public relation event. Also construct the first four public nonrelation events per field as negative controls, in source order. Retain all exceptions and failed checks.
construction: For prime subgroup order q and b nonzero mod q, compute S=(b^-1 mod q)U. Choose centered integer x,y lifting S on the public curve y^2=x^3-x-2. Set A=-1, B=y^2-x^3+x, E/Q:y^2=x^3+Ax+B, T=(x,y), P=bT, R=-aT. Check reductions of P and R separately against U,V and rational aP+bR=O.
scalar_replay: For positive events with a+b nonzero mod q, derive w=(a*t1+b*t2)/(a+b) mod q from the public relation and independently replay wG against the target point.
measurement: exact relation screen and constructive correctness panel; no wall-time comparison
